summary: Interactive Brokers Group filed an 8-K on July 31, 2026 to report a routine shelf takedown of 2,499,567 shares of Class A common stock via a prospectus supplement under an automatic S-3 registration statement. The shares are issued and sold to IBG Holdings LLC for distribution to its members in exchange for equal number of membership interests in IBG LLC, a mechanical exchange structure. No price, premium, or strategic event is disclosed. The filing includes a legal opinion from Dechert LLP. This is an ordinary capital-raising transaction, not a special situation; no risk-arb or strategic angle applies.
